notes: Starting cards marked '(Strt)' in the list: Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon, Jabba's Palace: Dungeon, Prepared Defenses and Power Of The Hutt, plus the Objective; these count toward the 60. Power Of The Hutt is the only Effect marked as starting, so it is the starting Effect (the matchup notes name other starting Effects per matchup).

The list as posted totals 58 cards, not 60; it is kept as published. Section counts as posted: 'Locations (8)' lists 7 sites, 'Inerrupts (15)' lists 14 cards and 'Effects (11)' lists 12. The 'Ships and Vehicles (5)' header is not a card.

Posted 'Audience Chamber' dested the Dark Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber; 'Great Pit' Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon; 'Jabba Dungeon' Jabba's Palace: Dungeon; 'Tatooine JP' the Dark Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'DS2 DB' Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'Dengar w/ gun' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'Mara' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (with Mara Jade's Lightsaber in the list); 'Fett w/ gun' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Bibby' Bib Fortuna; 'Lom w/ gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Iggy w/ gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Jodo' Jodo Kast; 'Chall' Chall Bekan; 'CC Engineer' Cloud City Engineer; 'Ephant' Ephant Mon.
Posted 'Evazan/Baba' dested the Reflections II combo character Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba (the 'Why This Card?' notes call it the 'Evazan combo').

Posted 'Sail Barge' dested Jabba's Sail Barge; 'Zukuss in ship' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Dengar in ship' Dengar In Punishing One; 'Iggy in ship' IG-88 In IG-2000; 'Bossk in ship' Bossk In Hound's Tooth.

Posted 'Prepared D' dested Prepared Defenses; 'Ghhk' Ghhhk; 'Control sfs x2' the Dark combo Control & Set For Stun; 'oota goota solo' Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?; 'Elis' Elis Helrot; 'You can't hide' You Cannot Hide Forever; 'Scum' Scum And Villainy; 'S+D' Search And Destroy; 'TINT/OE' There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'Disarmed' the Dark Disarmed; 'Mara's saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber.
Secret Plans, Resistance, No Escape and There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement are 2001 Effects (not Defensive Shields).
Blast Door Controls and a second Disarmed are named only under 'Card i like to add'; they are not counted.
Zack Phillips posted a later version of this deck four days later as Court of the Gangster Scum v2 (DeckTech 15525).
